Champagne

Run Windows games and applications on macOS with Wine.

Champagne is a native SwiftUI app for creating and managing Wine bottles. Choose a Wine runtime and graphics options for each bottle, then install and launch Windows applications from a macOS interface.

Champagne is an independent continuation of the archived Whisky project. It is not affiliated with the original project or getwhisky.app.
View releases Source code

What Champagne includes

  • Separate Wine bottles with per-bottle runtime selection.
  • A runtime catalog that verifies GitHub-published SHA-256 digests before installation.
  • Graphics backend choices, including DXVK and DXMT; D3DMetal is offered when the selected runtime supports it.
  • Launcher compatibility, Winetricks, troubleshooting, and diagnostic tools.

Requirements

  • Apple Silicon Mac
  • macOS 15 or later

Support

Read the support guide or report a problem through the issue tracker.
